meanings.note: The neuter form 'всё' used alone. Core Russian det meaning 'all, whole; everyone, everything' in everyday speech.
Neuter всё. Core Russian det meaning 'all, whole; everyone, everything' in everyday speech.

Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('tasty, delicious').

examples.trans: The bread rings are very tasty.

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, присядьте. Попробуйте чай с сушками, очень вкусные.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, have a seat. Try the tea with bread rings, they're very tasty.

meanings.note: В гости = for a visit. Abstract feminine noun formed with the Slavic suffix '-ость' ('-ness, -ity') from the corresponding adjective. Common masculine noun meaning 'guest, visitor' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Клавдия Викторовна, к вам гости! Па-пам!
examples.trans: Klavdia Viktorovna, you have visitors! Ta-da!

meanings.note: Core Russian part meaning 'even' in everyday speech.
Borrowed from French 'dessert' (from 'desservir', to clear the table).

examples.text: Гости в зале уже спрашивают новые десерты.
examples.trans: Guests in the dining room are already asking for new desserts.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('must, should; owe').

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?
Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forget', paired with 'забывать'.

examples.trans: Don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Сейчас будешь чинить трубу. И унитаз не забудь помыть.
examples.trans: Now you're going to fix the pipe. And don't forget to wash the toilet.

meanings.note: A fact or a person. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to know'.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

изменить.gloss: to cheat on, to betray; to change

meanings.en: to cheat on, to be unfaithful to
meanings.note: + dative (кому). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to cheat on, to betray; to change', paired with 'изменять'.
+ accusative (что). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to cheat on, to betray; to change', paired with 'изменять'.

examples.trans: Edik, I wanted to cheat on you.

examples.text: Эдик, я хотела тебе изменить. С ним, чтобы отомстить.
examples.trans: Edik, I wanted to cheat on you. With him, to take revenge.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'some, any', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: He is asking for some delicious dessert.
The guest wants some light salad.

meanings.note: Comparative of хорошо. Core Russian adv meaning 'better' in everyday speech.
Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('light, easy, faint').

examples.text: Я слышу странный лёгкий шорох возле стола.
examples.trans: I hear a strange faint rustling near the table.

examples.text: Зато мы быстро заработали лёгкие деньги.
examples.trans: On the plus side, we quickly earned easy money.

мешать.gloss: to be in the way, to disturb

meanings.en: to be in the way, to hinder
meanings.note: + dative. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to be in the way, to disturb', paired with 'помешать'.
Не мешай! = Don't bother me!. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to be in the way, to disturb', paired with 'помешать'.

examples.trans: The radiators are in the way.

examples.text: Филиппыч, миксер проехать не может. Радиаторы мешают.
examples.trans: Filippych, the mixer truck can't get through. The radiators are in the way.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'we' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hope, to rely on', paired with 'понадеяться'.

examples.trans: I hope so. Go on, act quickly!

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'питься'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'get drunk'.

examples.text: Шеф, зачем ты так сильно напился?
examples.trans: Chef, why did you get so drunk?

examples.text: Я не напился, а выпил немного аперитива.
examples.trans: I am not drunk, but drank a little aperitif.
Let me guess. You'll get drunk?

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
one direction, now; 'Неси!' = Bring (it)!

examples.trans: Yulia, bring a pen and a piece of paper.

meanings.note: used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.

meanings.note: ночью = at night; спокойной ночи = good night

examples.text: Ну что, Аркаша? Наступила ночь, просыпается мафия.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.

meanings.en: to change, to switch, to update
meanings.note: to alter or substitute something for a new version

What for? We swapped, it's mine.

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it. Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to understand', paired with 'понимать'.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'знаваться'). examples.trans: No way at all, I called your bluff. And you just confessed yourself.

meanings.note: Простите! = sorry! forgive me!. Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forgive; (imperative) excuse me', paired with 'прощать'.
Imperative: прости / простите. Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forgive; (imperative) excuse me', paired with 'прощать'.

+ с + instrumental. Prefix 'рас-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'статься'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to break up, to part', paired with 'расставаться'.

examples.text: Нет, я всё решил! Мы с ней точно расстанемся.

meanings.en: to be able to, to manage to
meanings.note: Perfective of мочь. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'мочь'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to be able, to manage', paired with 'мочь'.

examples.text: Я думаю, что у меня есть мужчина. Он сможет меня защитить.

meanings.en: to intend, to plan, to be going to

Pack or assemble. Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to intend, to be about to; to gather', paired with 'собраться'.
